items.text: Cardinals RB Jeremiyah Love (ankle) is ACTIVE. Risk/reward RB2 but starting everywhere; team wouldn't activate if worried about injury.
items.why: Expected to play per sources; officially active
items.implication: Start as RB2 with risk; limited practice but cleared
items.opportunity: RB2 role on depth chart; goal-line/third-down upside if healthy

items.text: Bears WR Rome Odunze (calf) is officially ACTIVE vs Panthers.
items.why: Expected to go per sources; not on inactive list
items.implication: Full WR1/2 role with Caleb Williams; start confidently

items.text: Weekend reports summary: Love and Odunze expected to play; Kamara not expected; Josh Williams activated (Sean Tucker doubtful); Nabers no news yet.
items.implication: Core inactive window guidance; Kamara impacts Etienne proj

items.text: Saints RB Alvin Kamara (knee/MCL sprain) is not expected to play and officially inactive vs Lions. Was full participant late week but not ready.
items.why: MCL sprain; not quite ready despite full participation
items.implication: Full workload shift to backup RBs; Etienne top-10 upside
items.opportunity: Unchallenged carries/targets for Etienne; Kendre Miller RB2

items.text: Ravens ruled out WR Ja'Kobi Lane due to wrist injury.
items.implication: Rookie out; snaps/targets to other BAL WRs like Flowers

items.text: Jeremiyah Love ACTIVE: risk/reward RB2 but starting him everywhere I have him.
items.why: Active despite ankle; Cardinals cleared him
items.implication: Must-start in most formats with upside

items.text: Patriots WR AJ Brown will not need surgery on high ankle sprain but sidelined 4-6 weeks.
items.implication: Long-term bench/IR candidate; targets to other NE WRs

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers OUT after meniscus trim Tuesday; realistic chance miss only one game and return Week 2 at Chargers. Team will monitor this week.
items.implication: Sit Week 1; stash for potential Week 2 return
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer elevated role/targets as primary TE

items.implication: Monitor closely; if out, targets to other Giants WRs
